entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
This is unbelievable. I've been on hold for ten minutes! I want to return something and I want to do it now!
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. I can certainly look into that return for you. I understand you're frustrated with the wait. Can I get your name and order number to start?
The name is Sam Jones. Order number is VF77819. I bought these ridiculously expensive cycling shoes and they're complete garbage. I want my money back.

Okay, Sam, I'm pulling up your order now. I see the VeloFit Pro-Pedal cycling shoes, delivered about 41 days ago. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

What kind of a question is that? My preference is to not have my feet shredded! I've gotten horrible blisters every time I've tried to ride in them. I've adjusted the cleats a dozen times, tried different socks, everything. They just don't fit right and they're painful. I want a refund, and if I don't get one, I'm posting pictures of my feet on every cycling forum on the internet!

I'm very sorry to hear the shoes are causing blisters and discomfort. That's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Please give me just one moment to review our return policy for this item.
Don't give me the runaround, Alex. Just process the return. It's a simple request. If you can't do it, get me your manager right now.

I understand your frustration, Sam, and there's no need for a manager. I can handle this for you. I've just confirmed our policy. For standard items like these cycling shoes, we have a 90-day return window.

Yes, that's correct. Since you received them 41 days ago, you are well within that timeframe. I can go ahead and process this return for a full refund for you right now. I'll email you a pre-paid shipping label to send the shoes back to us.
Oh. Well... okay then. That's... actually what I wanted. A full refund, you said?

Yes, a full refund to your original payment method. Once we receive the item at our warehouse, you should see the credit within 5-7 business days. The email with the label is on its way to you now. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
